meta.name: general-video
meta.description: Author or edit a custom HyperFrames composition when no specialized workflow fits, or when BRIEF.md sets flow: companion. Use for longer or multi-scene pieces, brand and sizzle reels, montages, static loops, static title cards, footage remixes, and freeform builds. Use motion-graphics instead for a short unnarrated motion-first unit, including an animated title. Route fresh creation through hyperframes before using this skill.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 剪辑出品牌片、蒙太奇、片头等各类自定义视频作品。
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要灵活创作非模板化的自定义视频内容。
copy.tagline_en: Produce and edit custom video pieces, from brand reels to montages.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need a flexible video creation tool for original, non-templated content.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会按 general-video 工作流帮你创作或修改多场景 HyperFrames 视频作品，包括品牌片、混剪、静态标题卡等；会先读项目状态、按规定加载参考文档，再逐步执行计划、分镜、构建与评审。
howto.when: 当没有更专门的流程匹配、BRIEF.md 指定 flow: companion，或你要做多场景长片（品牌片、混剪、静态标题卡等）时触发；全新创作会先经 /hyperframes。

say.text: 帮我把这几段素材做成一条 60 秒的多场景混剪。
先给一个品牌片的完整方案，我们边聊边改。
把片头标题卡改成静态款，并保留现有素材顺序。
say.note: 做局部编辑，不改动其他项目决策。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude follows the general-video workflow to create or edit multi-scene HyperFrames videos: brand reels, montages, static title cards, remixes. It reads project state first, loads required references, then executes plan, storyboard, build, and review stages.
howto.when_en: Triggered when no specialized workflow fits, when BRIEF.md sets flow: companion, or when the user asks for a longer/multi-scene piece such as a brand reel, montage, or static title card. Fresh creation is routed through /hyperframes first.

say_en.text: Turn these clips into a 60-second multi-scene montage.
say_en.note: Starts general-video, planning before building scenes.

say_en.text: Give me a full brand-reel treatment and we'll refine it together.
say_en.note: Companion flow: Claude first proposes the ceiling treatment.

say_en.text: Change the opening title card to a static version and keep the asset order.
say_en.note: Specific edit; other project decisions are preserved.
